leverage.exposure: No leveraged position is open: the balance is positive and the squad is at eleven with a legal shape. But a live offer is standing that would open one if it wins, and it would open one that cannot be closed. That auction resolves tomorrow afternoon, which is the deadline that matters — not the matchday lock. Repricing the offer to market value removes the exposure entirely while keeping the player in play. Leaving it as it stands means a negative balance at the lock is a live possibility, and a negative balance at matchday start scores zero for the whole matchday.

binding_gap: Defence, and specifically the cheapest defender in the squad, whose scoring rate is a fraction of everyone else's in the back four. He cannot be sold to fund his own replacement because he is worth almost nothing, and nothing on the board is both an upgrade on him and affordable without a larger sale. The Brackelmann swap does not fix this slot — it upgrades the slot above it — and that is the right order, because the board simply has no cheap defender worth owning right now.

verdict.detail: One action matters this run: the live offer standing on Brackelmann is far above the price this ledger licensed, and above what the named funding leg can unwind. Pull it and re-place at exactly his market value. The player is right — a clear upgrade on Deman at the same defensive slot, fit and in the probable XI on a source dated yesterday — but the price is in the contested high cluster, and every large loss in this ledger's history came from chasing a board listing into exactly that band. Repriced to market value, the swap funds itself off the Deman sale within two daily ticks, five days clear of the lock. Left as it stands, winning the auction is the bad outcome: it opens a deficit no available sale can close without dropping the squad to ten.

sell.reason: Deman stays the correct funding leg and the standing conditional holds without change: do not sell him until Brackelmann is actually owned, because selling first drops the squad to ten and triggers the penalty. If the auction is lost, he stays and the sale closes unexecuted. The manager ask he is listed at sits inside the range this league's most active relister asks for his own players, so it is not an absurd price — merely an uncertain one. If it has not drawn an offer by the back half of the week, sell back to Kickbase instead, which pays market value with no spread and rises with each daily tick.

standing.name: Olivier Deman
standing.why: CONDITIONAL FUNDING LEG FOR BUY Bnhqybx (Brackelmann). DO NOT EXECUTE UNTIL BRACKELMANN IS ACTUALLY OWNED — if the 11.10 17:23Z auction is lost, Deman STAYS and this call closes unexecuted, because selling him first drops the squad to 10 and triggers the -100 penalty. Sell back to Kickbase, which pays exactly mv with no spread. TIMING: after the 2026-10-10T20:00:00Z tick, which satisfies the third reversal condition on his block and is worth roughly +250k (mvt 1); in practice this is automatic, since the auction does not resolve until 11.10 17:23Z. WHY HIM AND NOT ANOTHER DEFENDER: he is the weakest fundable body in the eleven at ap 89, down from the ap 101 recorded when his block was written, and he carries the ONLY negative sdmvt in the squad (-517.913) while every other squad asset is rising. Selling ter Horst (ap 102) instead would buy roughly 760k more bid headroom but give up 13 ap; selling Gruber (ap 117) gives up 28 ap for the same money. Nakuzola at mv 500.000 does not fund anything. NEWS GATE PASSED: his block required a dated Augsburg XI of 08.10.2026 or later starting Brackelmann, with absence of news resolving AGAINST the sale; two independent dated sources now clear it (comunio 08.10, thehardtackle 09.10). NET: fielded eleven goes 1273 -> 1310 ap, squad stays 11, 4-4-2 stays legal, and the residual deficit of roughly 350k is inside one flip cycle with 5 days of runway.

buy.reason: Brackelmann is the only points buy on the board worth owning. He has started every league appearance this season, his club profile carries an all-clear from late September, and the probable eleven published yesterday has him in it. He upgrades the defensive slot Deman occupies by a wide margin per matchday, and defence is where the squad is thinnest in quality. Bid his market value exactly and do not raise: roughly half of all board purchases in this league clear at or below market value, so this is a real chance rather than a surrender, and the alternative is the band that lost this ledger Makengo, Mokwa and Banks. Everything else on the board fails: the three manager asks are all above market value from a rival who bought two of them at a whisker over market value hours earlier and relisted them at a markup, and the remaining board listings are either falling-trend players or forwards and midfielders who do not displace anyone already in the eleven.

movers.reason: The flip window is wide open — the lock is six days away — and the edge re-measures from the event log with no decay at all, slightly stronger than the figure the standing doctrine was written on. Ten board listings qualify on the full test: Kickbase listing, no manager ask, price exactly at market value, rising trend, no status flag. Bid market value exactly on each and never raise; lose the auction and it costs nothing. Two of them expire before the next run, so they are decided either way before the next briefing. One caution that outranks the ranking: a small listing cleared this morning at a third over market value, which is the clearest evidence yet that flip auctions are contested too. The rule is not a forecast of winning, it is a decision to win only cheap, so expect a low hit rate and do not read a loss as a fault in the method. Sizing is also tighter than the envelope suggests, because the standing Brackelmann offer is already committed against it, and every flip must be unwound to a non-negative balance and at least eleven players before the lock. The two standing open questions: whether the game caps squad size is now settled negative, so throughput is not capped there; and the edge is still measured in one league over one period and will decay if rivals crowd in.
